name: Cancellation negative credit at asset NET (not $0)
what_it_tests: A cancellation line (Qty=-1) must produce a NEGATIVE TotalPrice credit equal to the asset NET unit price (not list, not $0); the native waterfall seeds no NetUnitPrice for cancel lines so a custom seed supplies it
proc_mechanism: CancelNetUnitPrice__c seed (from AssetActionSource/SourceAsset NetUnitPrice) + V18 seed step; CancelLineCreditPosthook writes NetUnitPrice/TotalPrice/Subtotal via field-API names; Quantity*Price; Null-Safe Line Adjustment
expected_behavior: NetUnitPrice=asset net (e.g. 3000); TotalPrice = NetUnitPrice x -1 = -3000; quote/order header rolls up the negative credit
test_setup: Cancel quote/order, line Qty=-1, asset list 3000 no discount, CancelNetUnitPrice__c populated, expect -3000

prior_run.actual: Force-reprice ERRORS at StampBaseFilter#1 (SF-Pricing-00006 / SF-BRE-00004). Both fresh cancel QLIs stay NetUnitPrice=null, TotalPrice=0, Subtotal=0 (NOT -15000). Quote headers CalculationStatus=PriceCalculationFailed. Reproduced on 2 independent fresh quotes.
prior_run.defectStep: StampBaseFilter (parent StampContributorBasePreDiscount): criterion #5 NetUnitPrice GreaterThan 0 is not null-safe; condition logic (1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND 5 has no IsNull guard on NetUnitPrice. A fresh cancel line has NetUnitPrice=null so the rules engine cannot evaluate GreaterThan -> SF-BRE-00004, aborting the whole reprice before CancelLineCreditPosthook can seed the credit.
prior_run.notes: K-08 derived-cancel quote 0Q0WC000003FbLh0AK got -71 and prior 0Q0WC000003EQtl0AG got -15000 ONLY because their NetUnitPrice was already non-null (71 / 15000) so they cleared StampBaseFilter. Active runtime + design = Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 sole-active (ExpressionSetVersion 9QMWC00000025LN4AY). CancelLineCreditPosthook class 01pWC000002awnVYAQ present/api65.
